title: Levenda as the model for Johnny Depp's character in The Ninth Gate

tellings.quote: people around Depp were saying this actually happened.

plain: Peter Levenda, an author presented on Jesse Michels's podcast as a historian of the CIA, says he was the model for Johnny Depp's character in The Ninth Gate, a late 1990s film made by Roman Polanski. He links it to things he says happened to him in New York in the 1970s, and says people around Depp were saying the film's story actually happened.
